//: Gold for a family manifest. Learn this: one material line, written as a thing and what strikes it, sits on every sound; each sound's length fits its role; each file has its licence beside it. Run it with: node scripts/sound-family.mjs examples/family.json --provider synth --out public/sfx
material: felt mallet on a small wooden block, dry, no reverb, no tail, clean transient

tick.prompt: single very short tick, one-shot UI feedback, bright
tick.license: own work, rendered by scripts/sound-family.mjs, CC0, made in code

send.prompt: two very quick rising notes, a major third apart, damped, muted, very short decay, stops immediately, confirmation
send.license: own work, rendered by scripts/sound-family.mjs, CC0, made in code

receive.prompt: two soft quick descending notes, a major third apart, damped, muted, very short decay, stops immediately, incoming message
receive.license: own work, rendered by scripts/sound-family.mjs, CC0, made in code

error.prompt: short low dull thud with a slight downward pitch, rubber on wood
error.license: own work, rendered by scripts/sound-family.mjs, CC0, made in code

success.prompt: three ascending mellow notes, major, warm, short decay, completion
success.license: own work, rendered by scripts/sound-family.mjs, CC0, made in code
